Toasts

Short, unobtrusive alerts that appear and dismiss themselves.

Toasts are small alerts that appear, then dismiss themselves. They resize and reposition by breakpoint — try the button on a narrow and a wide viewport.

Toast is not in AutoInit(). Construct one when you need it: 

new RoutePlate.Toast({ text: 'I am a toast!' });

One way to hook that up is a click handler on a button:

<button type="button" class="btn tonal" id="toast-basic">Show Toast</button>
document.getElementById('toast-basic').addEventListener('click', function() {
  new RoutePlate.Toast({ text: 'I am a toast!' });
});

Initialization

The IIFE bundle exposes RoutePlate.Toast. Toast is not in AutoInit() and there is no toast() helper — construct one when you need it. 

new RoutePlate.Toast({
  text: 'I am a toast!'
});

Options

You can customize each toast with these options.

Name Type Default Description
text String '' Plain-text content of the toast. If set, it replaces any HTML from toastId.
toastId String — Id of a <template> (or another element) used as the toast body.
displayLength Number 4000 How long the toast stays before it dismisses, in milliseconds.
inDuration Number 300 Enter transition duration, in milliseconds.
outDuration Number 375 Exit transition duration, in milliseconds.
classes String '' Space-separated classes added to the toast element. rounded is included.
completeCallback Function null Called when the toast is dismissed.
activationPercent Number 0.8 Fraction of the toast’s width a drag must travel to dismiss it.

Methods

Instance methods are called on the toast. You can get the instance like this: 
const instance = RoutePlate.Toast.getInstance(elem);
.dismiss();

Dismiss this toast with its exit animation. Runs completeCallback when the animation finishes.

instance.dismiss();
Toast.dismissAll();

Dismiss every toast that is currently showing.

RoutePlate.Toast.dismissAll();

Properties

Name Type Description
el Element The toast element.
options Object The options the instance was initialized with.
panning Boolean Whether the toast is being dragged.
timeRemaining Number Milliseconds left before the toast dismisses.

Custom HTML

Pass toastId pointing at a <template>. The first child of the template is cloned as the toast. Leave text empty so the HTML is kept. 

<button type="button" class="btn tonal" id="toast-html-1">Show Toast 1</button>
<template id="my-toast-1">
  <div>
    This is toast nº1 with a <a href="https://github.com">link</a>
  </div>
</template>
new RoutePlate.Toast({ toastId: 'my-toast-1' });

Callback

Run a function when the toast is dismissed.

new RoutePlate.Toast({
  text: 'I will call back when dismissed',
  completeCallback: function() {
    new RoutePlate.Toast({ text: 'Your toast was dismissed' });
  }
});

Styling Toasts

Pass classes in the classes option. rounded is defined on .toast; you can add your own classes too. 

new RoutePlate.Toast({
  text: 'I am a toast!',
  classes: 'rounded'
});

Dismiss a Toast Programmatically

To remove a specific toast, get the instance from the toast element and call dismiss(). 

const toastElement = document.querySelector('.toast');
const toastInstance = RoutePlate.Toast.getInstance(toastElement);
toastInstance.dismiss();
Dismiss all Toasts
RoutePlate.Toast.dismissAll();
